static_traits.name: Zhang Siwei
static_traits.family_status: Lives with spouse and two children, raising two pet dogs
static_traits.social_status: has spouse and children's support, but stress and self-blame bring Relationship tension; hard to talk directly with family about feelings of failure
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, fairly strong logic, capable of self-Reflection, highly cooperative; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: intense self-blame and incompetence from this year's poor crop harvest, gradually developing into despair and worthlessness, significantly affecting Work motivation and self-esteem, accompanied by Sleep disturbed and Daily functioning impaired.
basic_info.core_demands: hoping to address and change negative thought patterns triggered by crop failure through counseling (e.g. catastrophizing, self-blame and incompetence).
growth_experiences: previously experienced crop-related challenges, but never such intense self-blame and despair; no past psychotherapy experience;No major physical illness.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/I am a terrible Farmer

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if the crop harvest is not good, it means my ability is insufficient and I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: constantly consulting other Farmers and trying to change planting techniques to prove competence

special_situations.event: Seeing barren plots or failed visual reminders in the fields
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I see failed results, it means I am overall not capable,no hope
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Thoughts of avoidance and withdrawal arise (such as 'I should give up'), reducing talk with family about failure to avoid being evaluated

special_situations.event: Small setbacks in farm work or minor operational errors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if any small problem appears, it must be that I did not do well enough, showing I will never master it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately blames the cause on oneself and tries to change the technical process to make up for it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never do well/learn it

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a competent and valuable person (accepted and respected at work and in the family)
core_conflict.fear: fear of being seen as incompetent, a failure, thus being negated or losing value
defense_goal: maintaining a sense of control over the situation through self-blame and attributing all failure to oneself, reducing anxiety about uncontrollable factors

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When farm work hits setbacks, or when failure and ability issues are discussed in counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: tending to believe others will see oneself as incompetent and feel disappointed (transferential worry about being judged)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using a gentle, supportive tone to first Empathize with the unease and burden; then Guide them to distinguish controllable from uncontrollable factors, broadening the evidence view, avoiding blaming language, and affirming the efforts.

manifestations: self-worth significantly declined after crop failure, producing the global label 'I am a failure'
feeling despair and worthlessness, shaken sense of meaning in Work and life
outcomes: Tense family relationships, limited communication with family

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: using Rigid self-demands like 'I should give up' and rule-based language
Equates output results directly with personal value and ability

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame; attributes problems entirely to oneself
Difficult to discuss failure and emotions directly with family, worried about being evaluated

positive_force: Has the support of a spouse and children, with a certain foundation of social support
In difficulties, proactively seeks others' advice and tries adjusting techniques
able to engage in cognitive Reflection and willing to practice new thinking and behavioral strategies
negative_force: A marked tendency toward self-attribution (personalization), ignoring external factors such as weather
catastrophic and overgeneralized thinking intensifying despair and worthlessness
Self-worth is excessively attached to yield and results, leading to all-or-nothing evaluation
difficulty communicating with family,Relationship tension, further reducing support availability
Sleep disturbed and increased stress, lowering Recovery and problem-solving ability

target_behavior.behavior: intense self-blame and negative Automatic thoughts like 'I should give up' during farming setbacks, accompanied by anxiety and grief emotional reactions and physical discomfort (e.g. chest tightness, labored breathing)
antecedent: Visual reminder of barren plots seen in the field
Minor setbacks or operational mistakes in farm work
Thinking about crops or being in a farm environment
target_behavior.core_reason: attributing failure solely to insufficient personal ability while ignoring external factors (e.g. weather), evaluating self-worth in all-or-nothing terms, trying to ease anxiety about uncontrollable factors through self-blame and internalized control
target_behavior.function: maintaining subjective control and escaping uncontrollable factors and others' judgment (avoiding uncertainty and shame)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work drive, impaired occupational performance,Impaired self-esteem and worsened despair; sleep and Daily life affected,Tense family relationships
